design: Same H413 panel/H416 maps/H410 groups/H418 output metric. Split head6 source into parallel to normalized recipient projection into head output subspace, plus orthogonal remainder. Fixed-scale group cross=PP+mixed+OO. Replay H418 FF per site. Joint6 component-fraction band for two angle changes using original per-condition full energy. Separate joint3 fractions for both-minus-actual raw cross numerator with common actual-full denominator, avoiding denominator-induced PP differences. No new selection or fresh confirmation.

gates.replay: maximum FF cross reconstruction error divided by original full energy<1e-9
gates.parallel_match: actual/both parallel amplitude difference divided by source norm<1e-5
gates.angle_parallel80: PP contribution fraction joint lower>.8 in both norm settings
gates.angle_mixed80: mixed fraction lower>.8 in both settings
gates.angle_orthogonal80: OO fraction lower>.8 in both settings
gates.actual_mixed80: mixed fraction of both-minus-actual common-denominator gap lower>.8
gates.actual_orthogonal80: OO fraction of same gap lower>.8
